context: Marketing and Booking Platform for Home Services

typography.headings: Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans, font-bold, tracking-tight
typography.body: Inter or DM Sans, text-base, leading-relaxed

key_features: Sticky Navigation with brand GngWar & tagline
Hero section with dynamic quick service strip
12 Distinct Home Service Cards with interactive duration & pricing matrix (₹75/₹86 to ₹439/₹505)
Comprehensive Booking Modal with service selection, duration, pricing, customer details & local storage persistence
Confirmation Summary screen persisting bookings in browser localStorage
How it Works & Why choose GngWar sections
Trust badges & placeholder About / Contact sections
Hidden Login feature (hidden until backend connected)
Responsive mobile, tablet & desktop layout with solid dark header and backdrop blur

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based testids on all interactive and key informational elements
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: WCAG AA compliant dark theme contrast

universal_guidelines: Never use full transparent backgrounds in headers without backdrop-blur and solid tint
Include data-testid on all interactive and informational elements
Ensure all 12 services have access to all 6 duration/price pairs
Store bookings in localStorage and display summary confirmation on completion
